mechanism_claims.claim_text: DN57opt and 1OAN1 act as dengue entry inhibitors with evidence for reduced virus-cell binding.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Hemagglutination inhibition was not detected; cell-binding reduction is source-supported but not a complete bound-complex structure.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: DN57opt and 1OAN1 with purified truncated DENV-2 E protein
mechanism_claims.limitations: Binding affinities are source-supported, but the source reports no statistically significant KD difference between the two peptides.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Post-infection addition assays support that DN57opt and 1OAN1 do not inhibit a post-entry replication step under the tested conditions.

mechanism_claims.limitations: This is a negative timing result; it bounds mechanism interpretation rather than proving a molecular binding site.
